title: Discovery of Voreloxin as a Dual-Selective Stabilizer for c-Myc/Bcl-2 G-Quadruplexes in Leukemia.
authors: Yin, Jiacheng; Jia, Pingting; Qu, Xinxin; Han, Zheng; Yao, Longsheng; Wang, Shangzhao; Gao, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子药物稳定c-Myc/Bcl-2 G-四链体以抑制癌基因表达，虽涉及DNA结构互作和MD/对接模拟，但对象为G4而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合机制，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Overexpression of c-Myc is a key factor in the development of leukemia and other malignancies, highlighting the urgent need for novel drugs to inhibit c-Myc protein levels. DNA G-quadruplexes (G4) have emerged as potential regulatory targets for c-Myc expression. Previous studies identified trovafloxacin, a topoisomerase II inhibitor, as a novel c-Myc G4 stabilizer. In this study, virtual screening based on structural similarity led to the identification of nine derivatives of trovafloxacin, among which voreloxin exhibited potent cytotoxicity in multiple myeloma cells and showed promising therapeutic efficacy in leukemia cells. FRET assays demonstrated that voreloxin specifically stabilized the G4 structures of c-Myc and Bcl-2, with minimal effects on the G4 structures of other oncogenes. Moreover, voreloxin significantly reduced the expression levels of c-Myc and Bcl-2 in THP-1 and MOLM-13 cells. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and MM/GBSA calculations further confirmed the stable binding of voreloxin to both c-Myc and Bcl-2 G4s, primarily driven by pi-pi stacking and hydrogen bonding interactions. These findings provide valuable insights for the development of G4-targeting drugs for cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: c-Myc的过表达是白血病及其他恶性肿瘤发生发展的关键因素，凸显了开发抑制c-Myc蛋白水平的新型药物的迫切需求。DNA G-四链体 (G-quadruplexes, G4) 已成为c-Myc表达的潜在调控靶点。既往研究鉴定出拓扑异构酶II抑制剂曲伐沙星 (trovafloxacin) 为一种新型c-Myc G4稳定剂。在本研究中，基于结构相似性的虚拟筛选鉴定出曲伐沙星的九种衍生物，其中voreloxin在多发性骨髓瘤细胞中表现出强效细胞毒性，并在白血病细胞中显示出有前景的治疗效果。FRET实验表明，voreloxin特异性稳定c-Myc和Bcl-2的G4结构，对其他癌基因的G4结构影响极小。此外，voreloxin显著降低了THP-1和MOLM-13细胞中c-Myc和Bcl-2的表达水平。分子对接、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟及MM/GBSA计算进一步证实了voreloxin与c-Myc和Bcl-2 G4的稳定结合，主要驱动力为pi-pi堆积和氢键相互作用。这些发现为开发靶向G4的癌症治疗药物提供了宝贵见解。
